headline: Rodri Chase Escalates, Barcola Deal Still Stuck
paragraphs: Manchester City's Rodri remains the summer's most contested asset. BBC Gossip reported in late July that Real Madrid were confident of signing him from City, while Sky Transfers separately said City had rejected an initial Barcelona bid as too low. BBC Gossip's Sunday gossip column now reports Barcelona have returned with a second, higher bid. That story also carries a BBC Sport credit, but BBC Sport and BBC Gossip are the same newsroom, not independent confirmation — and nothing in the feed says which suitor, if either, is actually ahead.

Bradley Barcola's move from Paris Saint-Germain to Liverpool is still unresolved. BBC Gossip reported in late July that Barcola had verbally agreed to join Liverpool but that the two clubs remained apart on valuation; its most recent update, from August 7, still described Liverpool as yet to agree a fee with PSG. Nothing in today's feed moves that forward — it remains a reported, single-outlet story, not a completed transfer.

Preseason friendlies gave the clearest facts of the day. Sky Sports reported Manchester City beat Atletico Madrid 3-1 in Seoul on Saturday, Omar Marmoush scoring twice as Enzo Maresca's tactical approach "began to take hold." Two more friendlies were still live when the feed was pulled Sunday: Sky Sports had Borussia Dortmund leading Arsenal 3-1, and Liverpool ahead of Monaco with both Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz on the scoresheet — snapshots, not final scores.
